channel.title: AI
channel.description: Muhammad Hassan Raza runs product and engineering at Entropy Labs, builds backend and AI systems that hold up in production, and gets patches merged into open-source tools like kitty, calibre and libtorrent.

item.title: RISQ
item.description: Scoring intake calls for mass tort firms: separating real claimants from coached callers, with evidence a reviewer can follow.

item.title: Scoring Fraud in Legal Intake Calls
item.description: Coached callers, invented doctors and borrowed photos. How RISQ scores intake calls for mass tort firms, and why the most useful score is the one that grades the interviewer.

item.title: Agent Middleware: What Kept Obelisk's Agents in Line
item.description: Obelisk runs more than fifteen specialist agents. Model choice, context, cost, retries and approvals all ended up in a middleware layer around them, and this is how that layer works.

item.title: LLMs Can't Save Bad UX
item.description: When an AI feature flops, look at the UX before you blame the model. Three features I watched fail, what fixed them, and the questions I now ask before anyone writes a prompt.

item.title: Structured Logging for AI Debugging
item.description: Logging one structured event per request with evlog, so an AI assistant can follow what happened in a request.

item.title: Anatomia
item.description: A nurse callback and case review product where transcripts, AI triage and follow-up calls all have to stay attached to the right patient.

item.title: Bonnet
item.description: An AI brand-development tool that turns a creative brief into research, strategy, creative direction, moodboards and a document a team can use.

item.title: LangChain in Production: What the Tutorials Leave Out
item.description: Where LangChain is worth using, where it gets in the way, and the defaults that stop our AI features failing silently: timeouts, validation, persistent state, tracing and pinned versions.

item.title: Obelisk
item.description: An AI marketing platform where specialist agents write, plan and analyze from a company's own material, without leaking one customer's brand into another's.
